posts.title: We’re Just Getting Started
posts.description: Super proud to have been one of 11 creatives asked to celebrate Milton Keynes’ UK City of Culture bid through a poster design. My submission, 1967, is the year Milton Keynes was founded, and was built from numerals found and photographed from across the fabric of the city. posts.title: Nobody Lives by the Grid
posts.description: Nobody Lives by the Grid is a beautiful new public art installation created by artists Ivan Morison and Heather Peak located within the Oakgrove community of Milton Keynes. The artwork features a series of striking bronze sculptures – The Witness and the Darling, The Stranger, The Tender Menace, and The Last to Leave – which were inspired by everyday forms and explore themes of community, ecology
